statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: For p, q in R^4 with |p| = |q| and a, b, c, d >= 0 with ab(c-d) >= d^2(a+b+c+d): a(A-B)^2 + b(A+B)^2 + cD^2 + dH >= 0. Equivalently EG <= (|D| + 2 max(|A|,|B|))^2 for all such p, q.

statements.label: T5 application
statements.restatement: With O = (x -> p x q) normalized, Phi_f0 = (A-B)^2, Phi_f6 = (A+B)^2, Phi_f10 = D^2, Phi_f54 = H. For c in the T_5 contact subspace, g = g22 f0 + g13 f2 + g12 f3 + g10 f5 + g17 f6 + g7 f10 + g16 f53 - A0 f54 (A0 = g16 - g0); if A0 < 0 and g22 g17 (g7 + A0) >= A0^2 (g22 + g17 + g7 - A0) then Phi_c(O) >= 0 on SO(4). Not claimed for all T_5 costs.
